decisions.reason: The revised Flat Plan changes the magazine's structural arrangement basis but does not alter the polished, modern, brand-aligned visual-style requirement.
Providing the latest Flat Plan does not change the requirement to remediate article image quality with AI when necessary.
The structural planning update does not change the required digital flipbook deliverable.
The latest Flat Plan does not resume or modify the deferred print-ready output requirement or its format, resolution, trim, or bleed settings.
The updated Flat Plan affects arrangement structure, not the specified website from which articles must be sourced.
The updated Flat Plan does not alter the requirement for every article to include the author's name and a small circular author photo.
